summary: Authors TransLaTeX translation rule sets: words, types, rules, and a self-validating test corpus.
in_scope: Word substitution tables (LaTeX token to replacement)
Named pattern types reused across rules
Pattern-to-expansion rules, including nested sub-rule maps
A [source, expected] test corpus scored against the rule set
TransLaTeX parser options (separators, intervals, text handling)
out_of_scope: Anything a learner sees — L0014 authors compiler input, not content
Spreadsheet, assessment or diagram authoring; those are their own dialects
Implementing the reducer functions a rule set dispatches to — those live in @graffiticode/translatex
